name: Armchair Detective Case.1
source:
"Armchair Detective" is an interactive visual mystery novel. The player takes the role of "Mirai Machina," assistant detective of "Sina Kusanagi". 

(Only the part 1 had been released. No news about further development since 2018)

[From [url=https://zeroayaadvangelist.itch.io/ad1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Armchair Detective》是一款互动式视觉推理小说。玩家将扮演侦探草薙椎名的助手莳苗未来。

（目前仅发布了第一部分，2018年以来没有后续开发消息。）

[摘自[url=https://zeroayaadvangelist.itch.io/ad1]itch.io[/url]]
